Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL1135903. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then compound_records to docs on doc_id. Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1135903'. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles, allowing nulls when structures are missing. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
